versions.subject: feat: more updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\AVKkid.dll'
filter_main_legit_path:
    Image|contains:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\G DATA\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\G DATA\'
    Image|endswith: '\AVKKid.exe'
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\G DATA\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\G DATA\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\AVKkid.dll" NOT (Image IN ("*C:\\Program Files (x86)\\G DATA\\*", "*C:\\Program Files\\G DATA\\*") Image="*\\AVKKid.exe" ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\G DATA\\*", "C:\\Program Files\\G DATA\\*"))
